description: This file defines the 'Details' feature within the Profiles module, including a query class, its validator, and a handler that reads a user profile based on username.

classes.name: Details.Query
classes.description: A request object containing the username to fetch the profile.

classes.name: Details.QueryValidator
classes.description: Validates that the username in the query is not empty.

classes.name: Details.QueryHandler
classes.description: Handles the profile read request using an injected profile reader.

methods.name: Handle
methods.description: Processes the query to fetch the profile asynchronously.
